question: Which Oct 16–17, 2026 Bundesliga Matchday 6 fixture will produce the most total goals?

calls.reasoning: Bookmaker totals imply expected goals of ~4.5 for Bayern-Leipzig (O4.5 ~+100), ~3.6 for Frankfurt-Köln (O/U 3.5 near even), ~3.0-3.1 for Union-BVB and HSV-Stuttgart (O2.5 ~1.50); the other three were estimated at ~2.6-3.0 from early-season goals-for and goals-against. With seven roughly Poisson totals averaging ~3, the maximum is shared ~35-40% of the time. Bayern-Leipzig is the clear single favourite but cannot beat the tie outcome. No prediction market found (Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi); bookmakers only price individual matches. The planned simulation could not run, so these are hand estimates.
